_comment: Source scripts for PTF_Sound. Edit text/voices here, then run tools/generate-sounds.py to regenerate the OGGs, cfgSounds.hpp and cfgModules.hpp. Voice names are Microsoft neural TTS voices (python -m edge_tts --list-voices); Latin American Spanish voices reading English text produce the accented English the Valmeran factions use. 'category' selects the sounds/ subfolder and the Zeus module category - 'generic' for campaign-agnostic sounds, or a campaign name (e.g. 'valmera').

lines.name: guardia_loyalty
lines.text: Citizens of Valmera! Do not listen to the lies of the foreign invaders. They bring chaos. They bring hunger. President Bastida brings order! Report all suspicious activity to your local Guardia post. Loyalty is safety. Silence is betrayal.

lines.name: guardia_curfew
lines.text: Attention! Attention! By order of the President, a curfew is in effect from sunset until dawn. Anyone found on the streets will be detained. Anyone assisting the foreign soldiers will be punished. Stay in your homes. La Guardia is watching.

lines.name: guardia_checkpoint
lines.text: Attention! You are approaching a security checkpoint of La Guardia. Reduce your speed. Turn on your interior lights. Have your documents ready. Vehicles that fail to stop will be fired upon without warning.

lines.name: guardia_reward
lines.text: By decree of the President: the Republic of Valmera offers a reward of one hundred thousand pesos for information leading to the capture of any foreign soldier. Speak to any officer of La Guardia. Your name will be protected. Your loyalty will be rewarded.

lines.name: guardia_weapons
lines.text: All civilian firearms must be surrendered to the nearest Guardia post before Friday. After Friday, possession of a weapon will be treated as collaboration with the enemy. There will be no second warning.

lines.name: regime_rations
lines.text: People of Bocachico: food distribution begins at noon at the municipal market. One ration per family. Bring your registration card. The President provides for his people. There is no shortage. There is no crisis.

lines.name: regime_evacuation
lines.text: Attention, residents. For your own safety, this area is now a restricted military zone. Collect your documents and essential belongings, and proceed calmly to the designated assembly point. Cooperate with the soldiers. This is for your protection.

lines.name: regime_victory
lines.text: Glorious news from the front! The heroic soldiers of the Republic have won a great victory against the foreign invaders. The enemy is retreating. Total victory is near. Long live the Republic! Long live President Bastida!

lines.name: bastida_address
lines.text: People of Valmera. I speak to you tonight not as your President, but as your protector. The foreigners call this a liberation. I call it what it is: an invasion. We did not invite them. We do not want them. And we will not kneel. Valmera stands. Valmera endures. Valmera does not surrender.

lines.name: sindicato_radio
lines.text: You are listening to the free voice of Valmera. The only station Bastida cannot silence. The President says there is no crisis. Brother, if there is no crisis, why is there no fuel in Bocachico? Why is there no medicine in Presa Alta? Stay smart. Stay alive. We will be here.

lines.name: sindicato_warning
lines.text: A friendly message from El Sindicato to everyone listening. The roads at night are ours. Soldiers: stay in your barracks. Foreigners: stay in your camps. Do not touch our cargo, and nobody has a problem. Touch our cargo, and we will find you.

lines.name: regime_morning
lines.text: Good morning, Valmera! Today, the President inaugurated a new school in Presa Alta. Sugar production has risen for the third month. The harbor of Bocachico welcomes two new fishing boats. Every day, the Republic grows stronger. Every day, Valmera rises.

lines.name: regime_martyrs
lines.text: Citizens. Today we honor the martyrs who gave their lives defending the Republic. Their sacrifice will not be forgotten. Their names are written in the soil of Valmera. Glory to the fallen! Glory to the Republic!

lines.name: regime_referendum
lines.text: This Sunday, Valmera votes. Vote yes for peace. Vote yes for order. Vote yes for the President. One nation. One people. One Valmera.

lines.name: guardia_informants
lines.text: The enemy hides among us. If a stranger comes to your village, if a neighbor asks too many questions, if you see lights on the water at night: report it to your block warden or to any Guardia post. Your name stays secret. Your duty is sacred.

lines.name: guardia_sindicato
lines.text: The criminals of El Sindicato are enemies of the Republic. Smuggling is treason. Whoever buys from them, whoever sells to them, whoever hides them, will share their punishment. The Guardia does not forget.

lines.name: pereno_muster
lines.text: Attention all personnel of the Seventh Infantry Battalion. Report to your posts immediately. All leave is cancelled by order of the commander. This is not a drill. Repeat: this is not a drill.

lines.name: sindicato_business
lines.text: El Sindicato reminds you: we buy fuel, medicine, and information. We pay in dollars, not in promises. You know how to find us. Do not come with problems. Come with product.

music.name: radio_jingle
music.text: This is Radio Nacional de Valmera. The voice of the Republic. The voice of the people.
